# Pull Request

## Task

Closes T-NNN (or "no task — explain why").

## Summary

What does this PR change, in one paragraph?

## Scope check

- [ ] Files modified are within the task's "Files in scope"
- [ ] No new dependencies (or: justified in `docs/architecture/decision-log.md`)
- [ ] No new TODO/FIXME without an issue link

## Verification

- [ ] `make test` passes (or stack-specific equivalent)
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the task are all checked

## Risk

- [ ] No changes to live trading paths
- [ ] No changes to risk gate logic — OR: explicitly reviewed below
- [ ] No new external API calls — OR: justified below

## Notes

Anything reviewers should pay extra attention to.
